summary: Backend regression after modular refactor of server.py (core/models/services/routes). 59 pytest tests covering all 10 scenarios from review_request passed (100%). NO regressions detected. All endpoints under /api/* return identical contracts to the pre-refactor monolith. Created seed: 1 throwaway iron-man user (deleted via direct mongo cleanup), 1 unlinked client (deleted via API cleanup), 1 carry-forward test client (deleted via API cleanup). Linked client record (CLIENT_PHONE) was retained because it pre-existed and is required by other tests.
critical_code_review_comments: core/deps.py get_current_user re-raises HTTPException inside `except jwt.PyJWTError`—fine, but a bare `except Exception` could swallow real bugs; current narrow except is correct.
routes/bills.py mark_bill_paid 'paid=false' branch sets balance to net_due correctly; status set to 'unpaid' even when net_due==0—minor cosmetic.
routes/clients.py delete-confirm path does not zero out delete_requested_at before cascade delete (it deletes the client so it's moot), but if any retry logic existed it would be stale. Non-blocking.

routes/subscription.py verify-payment marks order 'signature_failed' before checking ownership. Acceptable since signature is the primary auth; mismatch must always fail. Confirmed behavior matches pre-refactor.
services/bills_service.compute_status returns 'paid' when both net_due<=0 and amount_paid<=0 (zero-due bill). This is a legacy quirk; documented behavior preserved.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway iron_man user with random 10-digit phone (8xxxxxxxxx) for signup test; one unlinked TEST client; one carry-forward TEST client. All cleaned up in autouse session fixture. Existing seeded users (9999999991, 9999999992) and existing linked client record preserved; admin password reset on client user was restored to test123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_regression.py as the canonical regression suite for the modular backend. It exercises all /api/* routes including carry-forward bill logic (multi-month) and Razorpay invalid-signature handling. Activate endpoint correctly returns 400 when Razorpay is enabled. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_regression.py -v`. conftest.py provides BASE_URL via the public preview URL.
